- length (4 bytes): 00 00 00 08
- clientID (2 bytes): 00 00
- sessionID (2 bytes): 00 00
- protocolVersion (1 byte): 01
- interfaceVersion (1 byte): 01
- msgType (1 byte): 00
- returnCode (1 byte): 00
